howItWorks.title: Send the original.
howItWorks.text: Place your order and include a share link to the highest-quality version of the photo you have. Skip copies that have already been cropped, filtered, or compressed.

howItWorks.title: We work the whole image.
howItWorks.text: The file is sharpened, cleaned up, and enlarged as one picture — subject and background together — so the result still looks like the same photograph.

howItWorks.title: Get a digital file back.
howItWorks.text: Your print-ready file is delivered digitally in 3 days. One revision is included if you want a small adjustment.

faq.q: What file types can I send?
faq.a: Common formats such as JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and PDF all work. Send the original file rather than a version that has already been resized or retouched.
This package covers one photo. If you have a larger set, mention that in the order form and we can follow up.

faq.q: Can every blurry or damaged photo be saved?
faq.a: This price covers light to moderate work. If a face or important detail is too small or too blurred to see, it may not be possible to recover it accurately. If you are unsure, describe the photo in the form before you pay.

faq.q: How do I receive the finished file?
faq.a: The finished photo is delivered digitally as a print-ready file. We do not ship a physical print.
Typical turnaround is 3 days, and the package includes one revision.
